text: The third and final season of Narcos, an American crime thriller drama created and produced by Chris Brancato, Carlo Bernard, and Doug Miro, centers on the Cali Cartel. Pedro Pascal returns to the series in his role from the prior two seasons. All 10 episodes premiered on Netflix on September 1, 2017, and received highly positive critical reception. The show was originally renewed for a fourth season, which instead transitioned into Narcos: Mexico, a prequel/sequel companion series. On Rotten Tomatoes, the third season has a 97% approval rating from 23 reviews, with an average score of 7.46/10, and the critical consensus states, "Narcos continues to evolve in its third season, drawing on historical details to take viewers on a thoroughly gripping -- and unsettlingly timely -- journey into darkness." On Metacritic, the season is rated 78 out of 100 based on 9 critics, reflecting "generally favorable" reviews.
